what_it_does: FPUGen is a system that automatically generates custom floating-point math accelerators on FPGAs (reprogrammable logic chips) with configurable precision. It supports multiple precisions running in parallel on the same hardware: single-precision 32-bit, TensorFlow's 32-bit reduced format, half-precision 16-bit, and brain-float 16-bit formats. Users can dynamically switch precision to trade off between accuracy and power consumption during model training and inference.
